clue.text: A hotel employee's American trunks

definitions.meaning: a hotel's boot-boy or porter is traditionally called by this name in Britain
what Americans call a car's trunk is the British word for the luggage space, here in the plural

explanation.surface: A hotel worker's swimwear bought in the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses share one word: the old British name for a hotel porter, and the British name for a car's luggage compartment, which Americans call the trunk.

clue.text: Yell on entering the contest

parts.note: the whole clue describes the shout soldiers give as they charge into a fight

explanation.surface: Someone shouts as they enter a competition.
explanation.definitionFit: Soldiers traditionally shout a rallying slogan as they charge into combat.

clue.text: Clear through to the end of August

parts.note: over means finished, through, as in 'the game is over'

indicators.note: points to the final letter of the word August

explanation.surface: A clear run lasting until the close of the summer month.
explanation.definitionFit: Something open and plainly visible is clear rather than hidden.

clue.text: Nothing about a small figure in black appears convivial

indicators.note: the first three pieces sit inside the word for black

parts.note: sable is the heraldic word for black
O, the zero shape, means nothing
C is short for circa, about
I is the Roman numeral one, a small number

explanation.surface: A tiny figure dressed in black turns out to be friendly.
explanation.definitionFit: A convivial person enjoys company and is friendly and outgoing.

clue.text: In the main this will have to be raised for the viewers

definitions.text: In the main this will have to be raised for the viewers

parts.words: In the main this will have to be raised for the viewers
parts.note: the main is the open sea; a submarine's crew push up this tube to look above the water

explanation.surface: Something must be lifted at sea so that spectators can see.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The main' is an old word for the sea, which the surface hides as 'mainly'.
explanation.definitionFit: A submarine's crew raise this optical tube above the waves in order to see.

clue.text: Quiet place for entertainment

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quiet
to lay something is to place it down

explanation.surface: A peaceful spot for having fun.
explanation.definitionFit: A drama staged in a theatre is a form of entertainment.

clue.text: A person's leisure time

parts.note: the clue describes the years of leisure after someone stops working

explanation.surface: Someone's free time.
explanation.definitionFit: After giving up work for good, a person has endless leisure.

clue.text: Game press

definitions.meaning: a racket sport played against walls in an enclosed court

explanation.definitionFit: One word names the indoor racket sport and also means to crush something flat.

clue.text: Other cars are available for the players

indicators.note: the letters are freely available to be used in a new order

explanation.surface: Alternative vehicles can be had for the performers.
explanation.definitionFit: The musicians in a symphonic ensemble are its players.

clue.text: No longer scoff and leave

parts.note: ex means former, no longer so
to scoff is to eat greedily

explanation.surface: Stop gobbling and depart.
explanation.walkthrough: An EXEAT is the permission a British school or college grants a pupil to be away for a time.
explanation.definitionFit: This Latin term names the permission to be absent granted by a school or college.

clue.text: Keen to ditch a worker

parts.note: a trench is a ditch
an ant is the classic worker in crosswords, as in worker ants

explanation.surface: Someone is eager to get rid of an employee.
explanation.definitionFit: A keen remark is sharp and incisive, cutting straight to the point.

clue.text: A member of the family taking the pledge

definitions.text: A member of the family taking the pledge

parts.words: A member of the family taking the pledge
parts.note: a relative, and also old slang for the pawnbroker, who takes goods as pledges for loans

explanation.surface: A relative swears off alcohol.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Taking the pledge' sounds like giving up drink, but a pawnbroker takes pledges, and British slang calls the pawnbroker by this family name.
explanation.definitionFit: A parent's brother is a relative, and in old slang a pawnbroker accepts pledged goods.

clue.text: In the ballet "Halcyon Days" it proves fatal

indicators.note: the letters run inside the words ballet and Halcyon

explanation.surface: A ballet called Halcyon Days turns out to be deadly.
explanation.definitionFit: Something deadly causes death, so it is fatal.

clue.text: Putting a dunderhead in top position is most stupid

indicators.note: one word is placed inside the word for top position

parts.note: the crest is the summit, the top position
an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: Promoting a fool to the top job is the height of stupidity.
explanation.definitionFit: Crass means grossly stupid, so the superlative is the most stupid.

clue.text: Staggers, due to ill-fitting satin shoes

indicators.note: the letters of these words do not fit their present order

explanation.surface: Someone totters about because their satin shoes do not fit.
explanation.definitionFit: To amaze someone is to stagger them.

clue.text: Pocketing five hundred could seem awfully appealing!

indicators.note: the rearranged letters hold another inside, as a pocket does
the words are mangled awfully into a new order

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500

explanation.surface: Pocketing a big sum could look terribly attractive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'awfully' rearranges COULD SEEM; 'Pocketing' puts D inside that new arrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone huggable is lovable and therefore appealing.

clue.text: Sporting note a union's written

parts.note: D is a note of the musical scale
an alliance is a union

explanation.surface: A sports report notes that a union has written something.
explanation.definitionFit: Dalliance is amorous play or idle trifling, an old sense of sporting about.

clue.text: Boss of a breeding establishment

definitions.meaning: a boss is a raised knob or ornamental ...
a farm where horses are kept for breeding

explanation.surface: The head of a horse-breeding farm.
explanation.definitionFit: One word means both a knob-like ornament and a farm where stallions are kept for breeding.

clue.text: Put off fellow cleaner

parts.note: to deter is to put off
a gent is a man, a fellow

explanation.surface: A man who cleans is discouraged.
explanation.definitionFit: Washing powder or liquid is a cleaning agent.

clue.text: Discharge from a high-speed plane is not unusual

parts.note: a jet is a fast aircraft

indicators.note: the words is not appear in an unusual order

explanation.surface: Being thrown out of a fast aircraft is not uncommon.
explanation.definitionFit: To throw cargo overboard is to discharge it.

clue.text: The old record making one cry

parts.note: ye is an old form of the
LP is a long-playing record

explanation.surface: An old record that moves someone to tears.
explanation.definitionFit: A short sharp cry of pain, as from a dog, is a yelp.

clue.text: Oppose the law on place of business

indicators.note: one piece comes next to the other, added on

parts.note: a shop counter is where business is done
an act is a law passed by Parliament

explanation.surface: Someone objects to the legislation on trading premises.
explanation.definitionFit: To counteract something is to work against it, opposing its effect.

clue.text: The type with the right inclination

definitions.text: The type with the right inclination

parts.words: The type with the right inclination
parts.note: type here is printing type, sloping to the right

explanation.surface: A person with the proper leanings.
explanation.definitionFit: Sloping print leans to the right, as in this printing style.

clue.text: In it a man may well offer support

indicators.note: suggests the words may well be rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A man in a position might well provide backing.
explanation.definitionFit: To uphold or keep something going is to support it.

clue.text: Tree man, soft-hearted

indicators.note: one letter becomes the heart of the word for man

parts.note: male means a man
p is piano, soft in music

explanation.surface: A tree described as a gentle-hearted man.
explanation.definitionFit: The sycamore family of trees, with winged seeds and the leaf on Canada's flag.

clue.text: He says old coin is wanted

definitions.meaning: an ancient Greek gold or silver coin

explanation.surface: Someone says an old coin is required.
explanation.definitionFit: One who states something is literally the one who says it, and the same word names an ancient Greek coin.

clue.text: A service will follow shortly though, that's the point

indicators.note: the service comes after the first piece

parts.note: tho is a shortened spelling of though
RN is the Royal Navy, one of the armed services

explanation.surface: A church service will come soon, and that is the key thing.
explanation.definitionFit: A prickle on a rose stem is a sharp point.

clue.text: For sovereign and country

parts.note: a sovereign was a gold pound coin, and L is the symbol for a pound

explanation.surface: For the monarch and nation.
explanation.definitionFit: A nation or territory is a country.

clue.text: All the French backed the board

parts.note: pan is the Greek prefix meaning all

indicators.note: the French article is read back to front

parts.note: le is French for the

explanation.surface: Everyone in France supported the committee.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of experts or judges sitting together is a board.

clue.text: The principal's sound memorial

parts.note: the head is the principal of a school, plus the s of the possessive
a tone is a sound

explanation.surface: A head teacher's monument that is acoustically fine.
explanation.definitionFit: A grave marker is a memorial to the dead.

clue.text: Cut out without hesitation, so it's worked out

indicators.note: in the old sense outside, so one word goes round the other

parts.note: excised means cut out
er is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: Removed without pause, so it has been solved.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' here means outside, not lacking: EXCISED wraps round ER.
explanation.definitionFit: To exercise is to work out, as at the gym.

clue.text: Piece of music — a little number that's catchy?

parts.note: no is the short form of number
a net is catchy, it catches things

explanation.surface: A catchy little song.
explanation.definitionFit: A composition for nine players is a piece of music.
